root_cause.text: The `wave5_vpu_open_dec()` and `wave5_vpu_open_enc()` functions fail to free the previously allocated VPU instance structure (`inst`) when the subsequent memory allocation for `inst->codec_info` fails, resulting in a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that in both `wave5-vpu-dec.c` and `wave5-vpu-enc.c`, when `inst->codec_info` allocation fails (`if (!inst->codec_info)`), `kfree(inst)` is added before returning `-ENOMEM` to prevent a memory leak of the `inst` object.
